claims.claim: Clean and Sharp UK Used Canon EOS D650 DSLR Camera With 18 - 55MM Lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows Canon EOS 650D; Photo 2 shows an 18-55mm lens (18-24-35-55 markings) attached.
No photo shows a powered-on test, shutter count, autofocus check, or any functional verification; the seller text is truncated ('No...').

risks.risk: Camera may have shutter/mirror issues, weak autofocus, or intermittent faults not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A short video powering on, focusing on a nearby object, taking 5 photos, and showing the images on the camera screen (or a quick transfer to phone).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used DSLR with unknown condition (worst case: not fully working).

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus/haze/scratches or oil on elements; photos don’t show internal glass condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens front element and rear element (through the mount) under bright light, plus a test shot at f/8 showing sharpness and no haze.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens with possible defects (worst case: needs cleaning/has haze).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, caps, strap) or non-original/incorrect charger.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (battery, charger model label, caps, strap, memory card) and a photo of the battery compartment.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing at least one key accessory (worst case: no charger/battery).

risks.risk: Battery health/charging performance unknown; could drain quickly.
risks.proof: A photo/video showing battery level after a short test sequence (power on + shooting) and charger charging indicator (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery health unknown (worst case: weak battery).

risks.risk: Sensor dust or dead pixels not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: A test photo of a blank wall/sky at high f-number (e.g., f/16) and a zoomed-in crop showing dust/dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as sensor condition unknown (worst case: noticeable dust).

proof_requests: Power-on + autofocus + shutter test video (5 shots) with images shown on the camera screen.
Close-up clear photos of lens front and rear elements under bright light (check fungus/haze/scratches).
Photo of all included items laid out; show charger label and battery label.
Sensor test shot (blank wall/sky) at high f-number with a zoomed-in crop.
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Canon EOS 650D with an 18-55mm lens, but the key claim that it is 'working perfectly ok' is not verifiable from images alone. Functional tests and accessory confirmation are needed to price safely.
